description: A PHP script for managing code trackers within the TestLink project, including functions for initializing the page, rendering the GUI, processing user actions, and handling configuration and user permissions.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering of the GUI based on user actions and templates, including redirecting or displaying templates.

methods.name: initScript
methods.description: Initializes script components, including argument parsing and GUI setup.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Extracts and sanitizes input parameters, applying a whitelist validation.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI object with user permissions and related data.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has rights to access code tracker management.
